order-quote.name: Order pricing and discounts
order-quote.specification: Implement store.pricing.quote(value). value is an object with items (list of objects, each with integer cents and integer quantity) and discount (integer percentage from 0 to 100). Compute the subtotal as sum of cents times quantity. store.discounts.apply_discount(cents, percent) must subtract the percentage using integer arithmetic, rounding the final payable amount down to whole cents: cents * (100 - percent) // 100. quote must call that helper and return an object with subtotal_cents and total_cents. Empty items produces zero. Implement both approved modules. Standard library only.
